notes: The page says the 2026 grant award status was pending. The page does not state a wage.
name: Youth Conservation Corps Summer Trail Crew
org: The Family YMCA (Los Alamos and Espanola)
what_you_do: Summer trail crews work on trails. They work with Los Alamos County Open Space and the Espanola Ranger District.
who_can_apply: New Mexico youth ages 14 to 25. The page says jobs are open to this age range in general.
pay_detail: Paid jobs. Wage not stated on the page.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were due April 17, 2026, 6 p.m. Interviews April 20 to May 1. The page does not say when 2027 applications open.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. Get 2 character reference forms from people who are not family. Then interview. Paper forms can be turned in at the YMCA or the Los Alamos or Espanola Teen Centers. Questions: lzollinger@laymca.org.
